purpose: Correct the proven registration-critical Web server API base so the exact internal Compose authority retains the Nest global /api prefix instead of appending auth/staff routes to the container root.
acceptance: Production plaintext server authority is accepted only as exact http://api:3001/api (or the same value with one trailing slash, normalized away).
Plain http://api:3001 without the mandatory Nest global /api prefix is rejected fail-closed.
Arbitrary plaintext hosts, lookalike hosts, credentials, query, fragment and extra paths remain rejected.
Production fallback without explicit API_URL resolves to exact http://api:3001/api.
Explicit HTTPS server authorities retain the existing behavior.
No control-host, CSRF, MFA, staff authorization, tenant, role, database or network-security boundary is weakened.
Unit tests cover the exact canonical base and negative path/authority cases.
Production remains unchanged until a separately authorized exact-main REG.RU release.
